Surgical Interventions Register

Tracking all operative procedures: Primary resections, planned Redo surgery (second-look residual clearance), Surgery for recurrence, Surgery for metastasis, and CSF diversion.

Tumour-Related Outcomes: Residue, Functional Level & Complications

Dedicated paediatric neuro-oncological outcomes: Extent of Resection (EOR), 24-48h post-op MRI residue, Modified Chang metastatic staging, Lansky/KPS functional performance, and complications.

1. Extent of Resection (EOR) & Residual Disease

Confirmed by early 24-48h post-operative 3T volumetric MRI.

Paediatric Neuro-Oncology & Chemotherapy Input

Input from paediatric neuro-oncologists: Systemic regimens, infant-sparing chemotherapy, molecular targeted therapies (BRAF, MEK, NTRK inhibitors), and toxicities.

Chemotherapy & Targeted Therapy Regimens

Protocol / Regimen Intent Targeted Agents Start Date Cycles (Completed / Planned) Response (RANO) Toxicities Actions

Radiotherapy & Proton Beam Therapy (PBT) Input

Input from clinical oncologists and radiotherapists: Modality (Proton Beam vs Photon vs SRS), field planning (Craniospinal Irradiation vs focal boost), dosimetry, and fraction counts.

Radiation Oncology Treatment Register

Modality Treatment Field CSI Dose (Gy) Boost Dose (Gy) Total Dose (Gy) Fractions Completion Date Toxicities Actions

Neurorehabilitation Team Input

Multidisciplinary allied healthcare input: Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech & Language Therapy (dysphagia), and Dietetics.

Neurorehabilitation Goals & Progress Register

Assessment Date Physiotherapy (Gross Motor & Gait) Occupational Therapy (ADLs & School) SLT (Swallowing & Communication) Dietetics & Nutrition Assistive Equipment Actions

Neuropsychology Team Input

Standardized cognitive assessment batteries: Full scale IQ/DQ, verbal comprehension, perceptual reasoning, processing speed, memory, and educational statement (EHCP) planning.

Serial Neurocognitive Profiles Register

Test Date Battery Used Full Scale IQ / DQ Verbal Comp Perceptual / Fluid Working Memory Processing Speed EHCP & School Recommendations Actions

Discussions with the Family Register (Multi-Timepoint)

Comprehensive documentation of structured consultations with the child and parents across the entire cancer trajectory: Diagnosis, surgical consent, post-op histology debrief, radiotherapy/chemo planning, recurrence, redo decisions, and parallel planning.

Family Consultations & Goals of Care Register

Date Encounter Milestone Clinician Lead CNS Present Family Present Key Topics Discussed Family Preferences & Values Agreed Plan Actions

Database Export, Stata (.dta), Excel & SQLite Backups

Privilege Level: Administrator

Stata (.dta) Native Biostatistical File
Exports native binary .dta dataset with tumour histology, molecular subgroups, EOR residue, Lansky/KPS, Chang stage, and complications for immediate statistical analysis in Stata 10-19, R, or Python.
Microsoft Excel (.xls / XML) Multi-Sheet Backup
Complete spreadsheet export with worksheets for Patients, Surgeries, and Family Discussions.
Complete JSON / SQLite Registry Archive
Full transactional backup of the database including child tables and encrypted audit records.
Clone Database Snapshot
Create an exact replica clone of this registry database for isolated research analysis.
